Input

Generated from code Outlined only · 48px infix · states, affixes, selection controls

Real mat-form-field DOM rendered against the platform’s own Material CSS and overrides — each sample frozen in one explicit state.

Anatomy

Appearance is outlined everywhere — there is no filled variant in the platform. The infix is 48px tall with 0.75rem 0 padding, which is why a field and a size="default" button line up without any alignment work.

template
<mat-form-field> <mat-label>{{ t('order.reference') }}</mat-label> <input matInput [formControl]="form.controls.reference" /> <mat-error>{{ t('order.referenceInvalid') }}</mat-error> </mat-form-field> <!-- with a leading icon --> <mat-form-field> <mat-label>{{ t('common.search') }}</mat-label> <cca-icon matPrefix icon="search" /> <input matInput [formControl]="form.controls.query" /> </mat-form-field>

States

Empty — label at rest
Filled — label floats into the notch
Focused — 2px brand outline
Error — outline, label and message all turn critical
Reference must be 8 characters
Disabled
Required — asterisk from the floating label

In a form

template
<!-- items-start is required: each field reserves its own subscript space, --> <!-- so rows with and without an error would otherwise drift apart. --> <div class="grid grid-cols-2 items-start gap-4"> <mat-form-field>…</mat-form-field> <mat-form-field>…</mat-form-field> </div>

Never add bottom margin to a form field

The subscript area below the input already reserves room for a hint or error. Adding margin double-spaces the row, and the drift only becomes visible once one field in a row shows an error and its neighbours do not.

Selection controls

Checkbox, radio and switch are Material controls themed by the platform. The switch is mat-slide-toggle — there is no separate switch component.

Checkbox
Radio
Switch

The compact exception

A field inside a paginator is 32px tall

Page-size selects inside mat-paginator are the one place the platform shrinks a field, down from 48px. Do not reuse that height elsewhere.

Where this comes from

Every value on this page was read out of the platform source at build time, so it cannot drift from the app. Regenerate with pnpm design-system:export.
